faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do I create an account?
faq.a1: Visit /sign-up, enter your details, and verify via email. Profiles can be completed later.
faq.q2: What if I forget my password?
faq.a3: Go to /create-post, add title/description, tags, and publish. Edits are tracked.
faq.q4: Can I like or comment on posts?
faq.a4: Yes, interact via reaction buttons. Comments support mentions and threading.
faq.q5: How to join or create groups?
faq.a5: Browse /groups, request membership. Creators manage approvals at /my-groups.
faq.a6: Use /polls/create, add question/options. Votes are anonymous unless specified.
faq.a7: Customize in /settings/notifications. Mark as read or disable types.
faq.a8: Use the report button on content/users. Contact us for bugs via form.
faq.a10: Post, engage, login daily. View progress at /points-levels.
faq.a12: Check this FAQ or contact via modal.
faq.a13: Web-first; mobile-responsive. No app yet - but in process.

about.heroSubtitle: The interactive social platform where ideas connect and communities thrive.
about.missionContent: LIFEQS is designed to foster authentic connections through shared content, polls, and group discussions. With secure user management via Appwrite, we empower 500+ monthly users to create, engage, and grow—boosting interaction by 25% through gamification.
about.feature1: User Profiles: Customize with bios, images, and achievements.
about.feature2: Posts & Interactions: Like, comment, and track edits in real-time.
about.feature3: Groups: Build communities with membership controls.
about.feature4: Polls: Create interactive votes with results visualization.
about.feature5: Notifications: Stay updated on likes, joins, and more.
about.feature6: Gamification: Earn points and levels for active participation.
